description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Generator, which generates HTML from tokens, including functions to handle different token types, attribute generation, and optional tidying and newline normalization features.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML output from tokens, with options for XHTML output, script handling, and integration with configuration and context objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration and context, setting various options and internal properties.

methods.name: generateFromTokens
methods.description: Generates HTML string from an array of tokens, handling script fixups, tidying, and newline normalization.

methods.name: generateFromToken
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single token, handling different token types such as start, end, empty, text, and comment.

methods.name: generateScriptFromToken
methods.description: Processes script text tokens to embed them within CDATA and comment wrappers to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: generateAttributes
methods.description: Creates HTML attribute strings from an associative array, with options for sorting, minimization, and IE-specific fixes.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes raw text data into HTML entities.

search-terms: set of tokens for HTML output
